items.question: Manu faces the rising Sun. Which direction is he facing?
reasoning_points: The Sun rises in the east.

items.question: Facing North, which direction is on the left?
Facing East, turn right. Which direction?
reasoning_points: Clockwise quarter turn from East points South.

items.question: If a point is 3 steps east and 2 steps north of the start, describe its route.
reasoning_points: Record each direction and number of steps.

items.question: Why is a map key useful?
items.expected_answer: It explains the symbols used on the map.
reasoning_points: Read the legend before interpreting symbols.

items.question: Why can two routes between stations both be valid?
items.expected_answer: A map may offer different sequences of roads/lines connecting the same places.
reasoning_points: Trace each route and compare its steps/stations.
